verdict.rationale: Extend clearly supports running your own evals: it offers evaluation sets that score a versioned processor against every item and return aggregate metrics, and 10k free credits plus isolated test API keys let you try it before committing. The published-benchmark half of the story is unsupported, though. The only accuracy claim in the evidence is the marketing line "unmatched accuracy", with no published, reproducible benchmark methodology or results; one community user does praise extraction accuracy anecdotally. Missing for 10: published reproducible accuracy benchmarks with methodology/datasets, independent corroboration of the eval tooling.
